sut.text:
That's a frustrating way to end an event, especially with guests stuck walking blocks in the dark — I'm sorry that happened.

I don't have the authority to make a call on compensation or liability here, and I don't want to guess at something this serious. Let me get our events manager to look into this and follow up with you directly — they'll email you today. Can you confirm the event date and the name it was booked under so they can pull the details?
